entries.title: John 13:1
segments: Now just before the feast of the Passover, Jesus, knowing that his hour was come when he should leave this world to go to the Father, having loved his own who were in the world, showed forth his love to the end.

entries.title: John 13:2
segments: So while supper was proceeding, and the devil had already put it into the heart of Judas Iscariot, the son of Simon, to betray him,

entries.title: John 13:3
segments: Jesus, knowing that the Father had given everything into his hands, and that he was come from God,

entries.title: John 13:4
segments: and was now going to God, rose from supper, laid aside his upper garments, and took a towel and girded himself.

entries.title: John 13:5
segments: Then he poured water into the basin, and began to wash the feet of his disciples and to wipe them with the towel with which he had girded himself.

entries.title: John 13:6
segments: Then he came to Simon Peter, who said to him, "Lord, are you going to wash my feet?"

entries.title: John 13:7
segments: Jesus answered him, "What I am doing you do not understand now, but you will understand it later."

entries.title: John 13:8
segments: Peter answered, "No, never shall you wash my feet." "If I do not wash you," said Jesus, "you have no part in me."

entries.title: John 13:9
segments: "Lord," said Simon Peter, "not my feet only, but also my hands and my head."

entries.title: John 13:10
segments: Jesus said: "He who has bathed needs only to have his feet washed, and he is altogether clean; and you are clean, but not all of you."

entries.title: John 13:11
segments: (For he knew who should betray him, for that reason he said that they were not every one of them clean.)

entries.title: John 13:12
segments: So after he had washed their feet, and had put on his upper garments again, and taken his place, he said to them:

entries.title: John 13:13
segments: "Do you understand what I have been doing to you? You call me `Teacher' and `Master', and you say well, for such I am.

entries.title: John 13:14
segments: If then I have washed your feet, I the `Master' and the `Teacher', you also ought to wash one another's feet,

entries.title: John 13:15
segments: for I have given you an example, that you also should do what I have done to you.

entries.title: John 13:16
segments: In solemn truth I tell you that a slave is not greater than his master, neither is a messenger greater than the one who sends him.

entries.title: John 13:17
segments: If you know these things, happy are you if you do them.

entries.title: John 13:18
segments: I do not speak concerning all of you. I know whom I have chosen, but it is that the Scripture may be fulfilled, which says: "He who eats my bread has lifted up his heel against me.

entries.title: John 13:19
segments: "From this time forward, I tell you before it comes to pass, that when it is come to pass you may believe who I am.

entries.title: John 13:20
segments: In solemn truth I tell you, he who receives any one that I send is receiving me; and he who receives me is receiving Him who sent me."

entries.title: John 13:21
segments: When he had spoken thus, Jesus was deeply moved. He testified and said, "In solemn truth I tell you that one of you will betray me."

entries.title: John 13:22
segments: Then the disciples began looking at one another, wondering which one of them he meant.

entries.title: John 13:23
segments: There was reclining upon Jesus' breast one of the disciples whom he loved.

entries.title: John 13:24
segments: So Simon Peter beckoned to him, saying, "Ask who it is about whom he is speaking."

entries.title: John 13:25
segments: So that disciples just leaned back against Jesus' breast and said to him, "Lord, who is it?"

entries.title: John 13:26
segments: "It is that one," answered Jesus," to whom I am going to give a piece of bread, after dipping it."

entries.title: John 13:27
segments: So when he had dipped the bread, he took it and gave it to Judas Iscariot, son of Simon. And after he had received the piece of bread, Satan entered into him. "What you do, do quickly," said Jesus.

entries.title: John 13:28
segments: Now no one at the table understood why he said this to him,

entries.title: John 13:29
segments: for some were thinking, as Judas kept the purse, that Jesus meant to tell him, "Buy the things that we need for the feast," or that he should give something to the poor.

entries.title: John 13:30
segments: When he had taken the piece of bread, Judas went out immediately; and it was night.

entries.title: John 13:31
segments: So when he was gone, Jesus said: "Now has the Son of man been glorified, and God has been glorified in him.

entries.title: John 13:32
segments: If God has been glorified in him, God will also glorify him in himself, and straightway will he glorify him.

entries.title: John 13:33
segments: "My little children, I am only to be with you a little longer. You will seek me; just as I said to the Jews, `Where I go you cannot come,' so now I say to you.

entries.title: John 13:34
segments: I give you a new commandment, Love one another!

entries.title: John 13:35
segments: By this shall all men know that you are my disciples, if you have love one for another."

entries.title: John 13:36
segments: Simon Peter asked him, "Lord, where are you going?" "Where I am going," answered Jesus, "you cannot follow me now; but you shall follow me later."

entries.title: John 13:37
segments: "Why cannot I follow you now, Master?" said Peter. "I will lay down my life for you." Jesus answered him:

entries.title: John 13:38
segments: "Your life you will lay down for me? In solemn truth I tell you, the cock shall not crow before you have three times disowned me."
